scope: One fixed-index member of current-release full-population engineering baseline

calibration_unit.selection_rule: canonical full-population index; no outcome-based exclusions
calibration_unit.role: full-population engineering baseline; not a candidate experiment

generation.release_scope: current-public-release FP16 low-RAM engineering repair; no BF16 or published-row equivalence claim
generation.gpu_policy: exactly one freshly inventoried physical RTX 2080 Ti; UUID, driver, CUDA, total/free memory and competing processes must be retained
generation.optional_outputs: Blender animated GLB and PyTorch3D preview renders are diagnostics and are not required for ActionBench scoring

multi_arm_unit.native: the 16 meshes emitted by the pinned current-public-release generation
multi_arm_unit.world_gaussian: the existing deterministic sigma=1.0 frame Gaussian smoother in world coordinates
multi_arm_unit.body_gaussian: the existing deterministic sigma=1.0 frame Gaussian smoother after proper rigid pose factoring
multi_arm_unit.shared: same UID, generated native vertices, frame indices, topology, anchor and scorer inputs

official_scorer.role: engineering completeness/timing observation; no one-UID performance threshold exists

multi_arm_unit.timing_boundary: one harness-owned attempt from pre-model-load through all three retained official score rows and integrity collection
required_resource_observations: wall seconds for the complete boundary
baseline and peak device memory with sampling interval
host RAM and disk high-water marks
all process exit codes and timeouts

native_generation: generation report with exact command, cwd, environment, source/input/output hashes and stage timings
controls: body_gaussian sequence, pose factors and report
official_scoring: one raw official CSV and summary per arm
official source copies/patch identity and subprocess records
three retained metric rows including failures

forbidden_automatic_changes: reduce frames, points, arms or scorer settings
change UID, source, model or dataset revision
retry without a separately reviewed repair plan
natural_failure_policy.adjudication: Retain any failure as a failure of this explicit FP16 low-RAM repair. No automatic retries or further fallback.
natural_failure_policy.success_limit: A successful one-UID unit prices this exact three-arm engineering unit only. It does not establish the full-128 aggregate, scorer qualification or a candidate effect.

limitations: FP16 plus official low-RAM is an explicitly different numerical runtime; no equivalence to default BF16 or published aggregate is assumed.
One complete three-arm unit is engineering timing and integration evidence only; candidate qualification remains pending.

repair_lineage.review: FP16 and official low-RAM flags explicitly chosen under existing user authorization for 22GB inference. No automatic fallback; preserve all scientific budgets.
